ModMetaData.name: Dawn of a New Day
ModMetaData.author: AlenDio
ModMetaData.description: Adds a customizable header overlay that displays at the start of the day. Features Go to: Options > Mod options > "Dawn of a New Day" ∼ In-game settings preview button. ∼ Can be shown every X days if wanted. ∼ Can start from DAY 0 or DAY 1. ∼ Can toggle the Highlight background. ∼ Customizable Offset and Scale mode. ∼ Customizable Line width, thickness and padding. ∼ Customizable Display, Fade-In, and Fade-Out durations. ∼ Customizable colors of each text and outline. ∼ Customizable font size, style and outline thickness of each text. ∼ Customazible text for "DAY" and "YEAR". Can be safely added or removed from existing saves at any time.
